envelope.description: Integration and live tests, then docs

body.title: Integration and live tests, then docs
body.summary: Add the integration tests that run registered fake tools (structured and text-only) through callTool with the real executor, role taxonomy and router seam, proving too that the executor and convertText share one schema object, and the live test over a corpus of captured gh and git text outputs gated on INSRC_LIVE_TESTS=1. Update docs/daemon.md with the output-schema rule, callTool, convertText and the failure kinds.
acceptanceChecks: a structured tool called through callTool leaves the fake provider log empty
a text-only tool converts, checks and returns typed data, and a failed conversion returns conversion-failed with the raw text in failure.original
the live test skips cleanly when INSRC_LIVE_TESTS is unset
docs/daemon.md describes the rule that only code-called tools need an output schema

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/__tests__/call-tool.integration.test.ts: a tool with structured output called through callTool returns typed data
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/call-tool.integration.test.ts: a tool with structured output called through callTool leaves the fake provider log empty
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/call-tool.integration.test.ts: a text-only tool called through callTool converts, checks and returns typed data
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/call-tool.integration.test.ts: a text-only tool whose conversion fails returns a conversion-failed ToolFailure with the raw text in failure.original
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/convert-text.live.test.ts: convertText on captured gh and git text-only outputs returns values whose key values are in the text
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/convert-text.live.test.ts: a deliberately altered output fails the cross-check
